acceptanceCriteria: the dispute is settled by an owner-accepted spec amendment or decision, and any resulting fix lands with a regression test
body: Filed 2026-09-25 from the pre-1.0 expert panel review, main report §4 Disputed findings (scratchpad review/out/panel-report.md). Both verifiers confirmed the code facts; they split on whether the behaviour is a defect or an accepted documented choice. Owner instruction 2026-09-25: known issues are addressed before the next release. Settle the split (spec amendment or fix) as the finding's own 'Settles it' text says, then fix or record the accepted choice. Finding text: `affected` treats every shell line under any heading containing "verify" as a mandatory check, including GUI launch commands (go-runtime:cmd high; 1/2). Agreed and reproduced: `## Build / run / verify` in swift-videomover made two app-launching commands mandatory. Split: AFP-V0-009 specifies the substring match. Settles it: amend AFP-V0-009 to an exact heading or explicit marker, strip inline comments, and mark non-terminating commands advisory.

completion.reason: Settled: the owner accepted this finding's settlement on 2026-10-06, recorded as decision 0436 (docs/decisions/0436-panel-disputed-findings-settlement-accepted-2026-10-06.md at 07452b07fd8cfd4fc622ad90c673a323b3d6d495, PR beamfall/corvint#633; evidence digest is that file's sha256). The settlement landed on main in commit 753b0314, with the regression tests the decision table names (or a documentation-only scope change). No suite was rerun for this closure.
